title: Rear Low Kick
description:
1. Clear enough space to move safely and take a balanced starting position for Rear Low Kick.
2. Pivot on the lead foot, rotate the hip through a controlled rear low kick, and recover the leg to stance.
3. Work in the air or on pads with control, reset to guard after each repetition, and continue until the interval ends.
subtitle: Low Kick / K-1
